title: Less of a mall, more of a walmart
content: So like, you go inside the front door and there's a meat counter/produce section to the immediate left. Down to the right are the checkout isles, and if you go down there and take a left, there's a furniture section usually selling white sofas ore soft green furniture. Beside this is a rather lovely jewelry section with a TV screen advertising different brands. Further down you'll find a lego section with some antique bionicles and stuff! You'll never leave this store before night falls no matter how much you try and you *will* end up trapped overnight. The parking lot is elevated and the pavement stops at a pretty steep plateau. Not like a cliff or anything but you have to drive down to leave. A little bit out from there is a cozy little fast food place! They sell eggs, fish, and burgers. Sometimes Tacos.
